items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: do y'all care for somethin', Nick, do we care for somethin', Nick

ctx.x: and they got there, he said, we play St. Louis Blue, we figure out make them slack up, man, you look like they're right on top of that, man, dude, I sure look at that, I said, no more deal with the soldiers, she didn't have to ask me one time, do y'all care for somethin', Nick, do we care for somethin', Nick, man, they had a trough where they had water, like water where they put horses, full of it, she said, you always going to help yourself, she said, I know, Joe, you tired, I said, yes, ma'am, I am tired, I'm…
and so I would dry, yeah,
